title: 第13章 上班打怪下班泡茶第14章 高品质变异茶叶
content_zh:
“今天的目标是杀三百个骷髅怪！”
方南山登陆之后，匆匆削了三把剑，两把作备用。
昨天赚到的钱继续开启背包格子，花了一千五百块开到第八格。
这样就省了来回跑的时间。
买了两个馒头放在背包里，他提剑就走出护罩，此时外面已经又刷新了一批低级骷髅小兵。
现在他实力大增，打一级骷髅小兵只需要两剑。
几乎是走过场一样，一靠近过去，欻欻两下，骷髅就爆散，它攻击的动作甚至都还没有完成。
基础武器掌握达到熟练级之后，他对武器的使用又有了新的感悟，并且出手的速度更快更流畅，他会选择使用最顺手最舒服的方式出击，配上熟练级的身法，有一种飘逸潇洒的剑客风范了。
“听说如果自己把各种基础技法练到家，不需要使用经验值升级，只要系统认可你水平达到这个层次，就会自动晋升，甚至这种晋升给予的属性点会更多。”
机械的杀怪，捡材料，方南山的思绪难免散发开去，穿越后渐渐融合的记忆，也一点点浮现出来，这个世界毕竟已经不同，这个身体以前的经历也跟他有些异常。
但在教科书并没有关于这种晋升的方式，说明这种方式有很大的难度，成功率不高，允许大家私下实践，却不会推广。
他之前也凭着游戏经验，想着可以自行“领悟”各种基础技能。
但现实是，即使他制作出一阶的精良品质武器，系统依然不觉得他已经掌握基础工具制作技巧。
算了，现在他也不着急纠结这个，目前最重要的是刷碎片，修复现实世界中自己的身体。
一个小时之后，据点外面五百米范围的区域，所有骷髅都被他清理，一百多个一级骷髅小兵，三十多个二级骷髅兵，还有四个三级骷髅小队长。
然后他进入新的区域，这里不再有一级小骷髅了，最低也是二级，还有一种新的怪物，是三级的骷髅狼兵。
是骨头组成的野兽外形怪物。
骷髅狼兵敏捷很高，其他的倒跟骷髅小队长差不多，防御可能会低一些。
但对方南山来说，这都不是问题，这些怪物再高的敏捷，也不可能比他现在高，他走的是均衡路线，所有属性都有20+，可以说是没有短板。
前面刷怪得到的八百经验值，他先是升到了二级，然后把【腾龙十式】从入门级提升到熟练级，这个基础功法的提升，有等级要求，一级的时候还点不了提升。

体式的提升是一个巨大的提升，跟初学一样，有二十点属性的增加，方南山四项属性同时+5，加上之前升二级的时候他全加在力量上。
因此进入三级怪物区的时候，他的力量已经是30+2+1，基础攻击就达到了66，加上木剑，以及基础武器掌握的伤害加成，他的攻击轻松突破八十，每一击打在骷髅狼兵身上，都掉50+的血量，它们三百的血也只能撑六下。
“击杀三级骷髅魔狼，经验+15，功勋+3。”
“魔晶*3，狼骨牙*3。”
拾取的材料，从硬化骨，变成了狼骨牙，但都是同一个层次的硬骨，只是不同的怪物，掉落的材料略有差异。
他又斩杀三十只骷髅魔狼，期间碰上一只四级的魔狼小队长，花费了十分钟才将其斩杀。
魔狼小队长给了两件装备，一是狼骨牙项链，但属性也只比骨质项链多了一点力量加成，另一件是狼爪手套，力量+2，攻击力+8，是一件武器。
“木剑又全部破碎了，打这些高级的骷髅怪，装备的耐久掉得更快，还不到两个小时，就磨损了我三把木剑。”
方南山也感觉略有些疲惫，两个馒头都吃了，体力是补充好，但精神的消耗一时难以恢复，需要休整一下。
content_en:
"Today's goal is to kill three hundred skeleton monsters!"
After Fang Nanshan landed, he hastily cut three swords and kept two as spares.
The money earned yesterday continued to open the backpack grid, and I spent 1,500 yuan to open it to the eighth grid.
This saves time running back and forth.
After buying two steamed buns and putting them in his backpack, he picked up his sword and walked out of the shield. At this time, another batch of low-level skeleton soldiers had been refreshed outside.
Now that his strength has greatly increased, he only needs two swords to defeat a level one skeleton minion.
It was almost like going through the motions. As soon as he got close to it, after two clicks, the skeleton exploded. It hadn't even finished its attack.
After mastering the basic weapons and reaching the proficiency level, he has a new understanding of the use of weapons, and his shooting speed is faster and smoother. He will choose to use the most convenient and comfortable way to attack. Coupled with the proficiency level of movement, he has an elegant and unrestrained swordsman style.
"I heard that if you master various basic techniques, you don't need to use experience points to upgrade. As long as the system recognizes that your level has reached this level, you will be automatically promoted. This promotion will even give you more attribute points."
Mechanically killing monsters and picking up materials, Fang Nanshan's thoughts inevitably spread out, and the memories that gradually merged after time travel also emerged bit by bit. After all, the world was different, and the previous experiences of this body were also a little strange to him.
However, there is no mention of this method of promotion in the textbooks, indicating that this method is very difficult and has a low success rate. It is allowed to be practiced privately, but will not be promoted.
He had also relied on his gaming experience before, thinking that he could "understand" various basic skills on his own.
But the reality is that even if he makes a first-level high-quality weapon, the system still does not feel that he has mastered the basic tool making skills.
Forget it, he is not in a hurry to worry about this now. The most important thing at the moment is to collect the fragments and repair his body in the real world.
An hour later, he cleared all the skeletons in the area of ​​500 meters outside the stronghold, including more than a hundred first-level skeleton soldiers, more than thirty second-level skeleton soldiers, and four third-level skeleton squad leaders.
Then he entered a new area. There were no longer level one skeletons here, the lowest level was level two. There was also a new monster, a level three skeleton wolf soldier.
It is a beast-like monster made of bones.
The Skeleton Wolf Soldier has high agility, but the others are similar to the Skeleton Squad Leader, and their defense may be lower.
But for Fang Nanshan, this is not a problem. No matter how high the agility of these monsters is, they cannot be higher than him now. He is taking a balanced route, with all attributes being 20+. It can be said that he has no shortcomings.
With the 800 experience points obtained from the previous monster grinding, he first upgraded to the second level, and then upgraded the [Tenglong Ten Styles] from the entry level to the proficient level. There are level requirements for the improvement of this basic skill, and you cannot upgrade it at the first level.
The improvement of posture is a huge improvement. Just like the beginner, there is a twenty-point increase in attributes. Fang Nanshan's four attributes are +5 at the same time. In addition, when he was promoted to the second level before, he all added to strength.
Therefore, when he entered the third-level monster area, his strength was already 30+2+1, and his basic attack reached 66. With the damage bonus of the wooden sword and basic weapons, his attack easily exceeded 80. Every hit on the skeleton wolf soldier lost 50+ health, and their 300 health could only last six times.
"Kill the third-level skeleton demon wolf, experience +15, merit +3."
"Magic Crystal*3, Wolf Bone Teeth*3."
The materials picked up changed from hardened bones to wolf bones and teeth, but they were all the same level of hardened bones, but different monsters dropped slightly different materials.
He killed thirty more skeleton demon wolves, during which time he encountered a level four demon wolf squad leader, and it took him ten minutes to kill him.
The captain of the Demon Wolf Squad gave him two pieces of equipment. One is the wolf bone and tooth necklace, but its attributes only have a little more strength bonus than the bone necklace., the other one is Wolf Claw Gloves, strength +2, attack power +8, it is a weapon.
"The wooden swords are all broken again. When fighting these high-level skeleton monsters, the durability of the equipment decreases faster. In less than two hours, three of my wooden swords were worn out."
Fang Nanshan also felt a little tired. After eating two steamed buns, his physical strength was replenished, but it was difficult to recover from the mental exhaustion and he needed to take a rest.
